prompt: Estimate typical material-property PRIORS for these already identified surface materials: ["fabric", "wood"]. These are conditional nominal estimates, not measurements and not whole-upholstery effective properties. Give reasonable numeric central values and broad ranges for density and Young's modulus when a material-level value is meaningful. For wood use longitudinal modulus, unknown species. For textile use an explicitly assumed effective in-plane tensile modulus. Define friction as static friction for a clean DRY stainless-steel slider against this material under light contact at room temperature. State that exact surface finish is unresolved. Define hardness using Shore D only when meaningful; textile has no useful bulk Shore D hardness and must be null. Do not copy null schema examples for all other properties. Return JSON {materials:[{name:string, density_kg_m3:number, density_range:[low,high], youngs_modulus_pa:number or null, modulus_direction:string, friction_coefficient:number or null, friction_contact_pair:'dry stainless steel slider / material', hardness_value:number or null, hardness_scale:'Shore D' or null, assumptions:string}]}. Do not fabricate a literature citation.
